description: S.S. Oil Mills Limited is a Pakistani edible-oil processor incorporated in August 1990, with a solvent extraction and refining plant at Vehari in Punjab. It processes canola, sunflower and soybean into cooking oils and protein meals, and describes itself as one of the country's largest edible oil processors and the second-largest importer of oilseeds.
sourceNote: Written from: ssgroup.pk/ss-oil-mills-ltd/ (company profile, products and head office contact) and ssoil.ssgroup.pk/SSOilEng/AboutUs.html (accessed 2026-10-17). No chief executive is named on the company's own site, so ceo is null.
